questions.question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All humans are parents.

All parents are teachers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some teachers are parents.

II. Some teachers are humans.

options.text: Either conclusion I or II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is as follows,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/348d49acba3b3983e4dfb34477b6bd5e44e7f71e0ca470fe0d7a61f3b326ed76.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some teachers are parents → True, as all parents are teachers, some teachers will definitely be the parents.

II. Some teachers are humans → True, as all humans are parents and all parents are teachers, some teachers will definitely be the humans.

Hence, both the conclusion I and II follow.

questions.question:
Select the term that will come next in the following series.

2, 7, 17, 32, 52, ?

Select the letter cluster that will come next in the following series.

GZI, HYJ, IXK, JWL, ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f0a3e32b57e2393fbe73836962f87739b4ab822af37a0422d586f9f9d371458.png] 

For 1st letter of each word, G + 1 = H; H + 1 = I; I + 1 = J; J + 1 = **K**

For 2ⁿd letter of each word, Z - 1 = Y; Y - 1 = X; X - 1 = W; W - 1 = **V**

For 3rd letter of each word, I + 1 = J; J + 1 = K; K + 1 = L; L + 1 = **M**

Hence, ‘**KVM**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

12 × 8 ÷ 36 + 3 - 6 = 102
questions.solution:
Interchanging × and +

12 + 8 ÷ 36 + 3 – 6 = 12 + 22 + 3 - 6

9.22 ≠ 102

Interchanging + and -

12 × 8 ÷ 36 - 3 + 6

= 12 × .22 - 3 + 6

= 5.22 ≠ 102

Interchanging - and ÷

12 × 8 - 36 + 3 ÷ 6

= 96 - 36 + .5

= 60 + .5

= 60.5 ≠ 102

Interchanging ÷ and +

12 × 8 + 36 ÷ 3 - 6

= 12 × 8 + 12 - 6

= 96 + 12 - 6

= 108 - 6

= 102 = 102

Hence, by interchanging ÷ and + we get the correct equation.

questions.question: Vishal is three times as old as Saksham. After 8 years, he will be two times as old as Saksham. After further 8 years, what will be Vishal’s age?
questions.solution:
Let present age of Saksham be x, therefore age of Vishal will be 3x.

Age of Saksham after 8 years = x + 8,

According to the question age of Vishal after 8 years

= 2(x + 8).

And also, age of Vishal after 8 years = 3x + 8.

Comparing Vishal age after 8 years we get,

3x + 8 = 2(x + 8)

3x + 8 = 2x + 16

3x - 2x = 16 - 8

X = 8

Present age of Saksham = 8 years and age of Vishal = 3 × 8 = 24

Hence, Age of Saksham and Vishal after 8 year = 8 + 8 = 16 and 24 + 8 = 32

Age of Saksham and Vishal after 8 more years = 16 + 8 = 24 and 32 + 8 = 40

Hence, '40 years’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: If N = 28 and ORE = 76, then how will you code PALE?
questions.solution:
According to the positions of the alphabets in the alphabetical series,

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f0a3e32b57e2393fbe73836962f87739b4ab822af37a0422d586f9f9d371458.png] 

N = 14; 14 × 2 = 28;

ORE = 15 + 18 + 5 = 38; 38 × 2 = 76; 

Similarly,

PALE = 16 + 1 + 12 + 5 = 34; 34 × 2 = 68

Hence, 68 is the correct answer
